_comment: Windows + tastytrade. Copy to config.json. The PC is the broker: this file cannot select IBKR. auto on Windows is tastytrade. tasty_orders=sandbox (the default) sends to api.cert.tastyworks.com. tasty_orders=production is real money and requires tasty_data=production. There is no env toggle. run_session.ps1 defaults to dry. -Mode live auto-approves; it does not ask for yes <ticketID>. --broker schwab is the old confirm-before-send path.
_rules: Version B only. 15m closes 12:00–1:00 PM ET, first qualifying bar, 1 spread. Long nearest 75 delta. Width max(10, floor(EM/5)*5) where EM is the ATM straddle mid. Limit at mid. Skip if the marketable debit is more than $0.20 per side worse than mid. GTC close at debit x 1.30. Flat 2 hours after the entry bar. No stop. Tastytrade does not chase a missed fill.
_wrap: Read-only log summary: python -m spx_noon wrap (run_wrap.ps1). It does not send orders.
